title: Tennis Centre

services.name: Permanent Court Time
services.desc: A $250 booking fee per court is required to secure permanent court time, which allows you to reserve the same day and time each week. Court time must be pre-paid ($70 an hour + HST) and booked for a minimum of 10 weeks. Bookings are offered on a first-come, first-served basis, with priority given to returning

explain.meaning: A booked slot on a court for your own game.

services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: The Carleton Tennis Camp is led by certified coaches and uses the progressive tennis approach, adapting the court size and equipment to suit the age and development of each player. Campers spend 3-4 hours on court each day and are grouped with players of a similar skill level to ensure they get the most out of their time on court. Campers are divided into two age groups, with court size and equipment tailored to each: In addition to tennis, campers will also enjoy a daily cafeteria lunch, recreational swim time, a tennis camp t-shirt, and a variety of other sports and activities offered in partnership with Carleton’s popular Sports Camp
